feedback: The current implementation passes the provided acceptance tests but does not fully satisfy the specification. Several UI and accessibility requirements are missing or only partially met (Wordmark text, responsive breakpoint, heading fonts, correct colour usage, proper hero CTA markup, and labeling of training learn lists). Update the code as described above to address these gaps.
unproven: Wordmark component (src/components/Wordmark.tsx) does not include the visible text "The Bayes Group" inside the SVG. It only provides an aria‑label. Add a <text> element (or equivalent) to render the name within the SVG so that the logo meets requirement R7.

Header navigation collapses at 420 px (both the JavaScript isMobile check and the CSS @media rule). Specification R9 requires collapse at ≤390 px. Update the width checks to use 390 px (e.g., window.innerWidth <= 390 and @media (max-width: 390px)).

Headings are not globally styled with the serif system‑font stack. Only .hero h1 uses var(--font-serif). Add a CSS rule (e.g., h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 { font-family: var(--font-serif); }) so that all headings satisfy requirement R6.

Primary CTA button (.button-primary) uses a custom dark teal colour (#0c5a5a) instead of the required accent teal (#1F8A8A) defined in --color-accent. Change the background to var(--color-accent) (and adjust hover/active states accordingly) to satisfy requirement R5.

Home hero contains a <button> element for the "Explore services" action. Requirement R15 states that both CTAs must be <a> (link) elements. Replace the <button> with a <Link> (or <a>) that navigates to "/services" and remove the duplicate link, ensuring only two link‑styled CTAs are present.

Training page course cards display the list of learn items without a preceding label such as "You will learn". Add a heading or paragraph (e.g.,

You will learn

or

You will learn

) before the
    in each card to meet requirement R29.
open_notes: R6: Headings are not using the serif font stack. In src/index.css only .hero h1 sets font-family to var(--font-serif); other headings (h2, h3, h4) inherit the sans‑serif body font. Add a rule (e.g., h1, h2, h3, h4 { font-family: var(--font-serif); }) so all headings use the serif system font stack.

R7: The Wordmark SVG does not contain visible text. src/components/Wordmark.tsx renders only a <path> and supplies an aria-label, but the specification requires the inline SVG to include the text "The Bayes Group" next to the bell‑curve graphic. Update the component to add a <text> element (or embed the text in the SVG) showing "The Bayes Group".

R9: Header navigation collapses at window.innerWidth < 420px, while the spec requires collapse on screens ≤ 390px. In src/components/Header.tsx the isMobile state is initialized with window.innerWidth < 420 and the resize handler uses the same threshold. Change the threshold to 390 (use <= 390) so the menu button appears only on screens 390px wide or smaller.

R24: The Custom Development service list item for LLM applications omits parentheses around "RAG". In src/pages/Services.tsx the line reads "LLM and retrieval-augmented RAG applications". Update it to "LLM and retrieval-augmented (RAG) applications" to match the specification.
